tideland.subtitle_zh: 永昌堡外 · 潮沟、盐坂与旧海塘
tideland.subtitle_en: Beyond Yongchang Fort · tide creeks, salt pans, and the old seawall
tideland.description_zh: 开阔滩涂被两条潮沟切开，盐坂与旧海塘形成可绕行的天然屏障。标准敌速、标准灯油消耗。
tideland.description_en: Open flats split by two tide creeks, with salt-pan levees and the old seawall as natural cover. Standard speed and oil drain.

watergate.subtitle_zh: 永昌堡 · 护城河、双渠与四水门
watergate.subtitle_en: Yongchang Fort · moat, twin canals, and four water gates
watergate.description_zh: 护城河与两条南北水渠把战场切成桥头、城台和堤道。敌潮从陆门与水门涌入，桥面是必经之路。
watergate.description_en: A moat and two north-south canals split the field into bridgeheads, wall platforms, and causeways. The tide enters through land and water gates, and every bridge becomes a chokepoint.

crossstreet.subtitle_zh: 永昌堡内 · 双渠、十字主街与铺面
crossstreet.subtitle_en: Inside Yongchang Fort · twin canals, cross streets, and shopfronts
crossstreet.description_zh: 两渠夹出狭长街坊，十字主街与横巷把战场切成多个火力口。桥面、门洞和街角决定走位。
crossstreet.description_en: Two canals carve long blocks, while the cross streets turn the fort into a chain of firing lanes. Bridges, gate passages, and corners decide every movement.
